name: page-split
description: Copy-and-image row for the 2026 company and resource pages: eyebrow, heading (or a large pull quote), paragraphs with inline links, bullets, a person line, arrow links (one or two columns), and up to two buttons beside a photo, illustration or framed screenshot; image left or right, stacked on phones. Without an image the copy centres (an intro band). Tones: white, the soft brand wash, or a rounded off-white panel (live's rounded sections).

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

tone.description: white; soft: slate-50 with brand orbs; panel: a rounded off-white card holding the row.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

quote.description: Set the heading as a large pull quote (quote mark, 32px) — live's CEO quote on /our-company/ is the page's first h2.

body.description: Copy. A blank line starts a new paragraph; single line breaks are kept; [label](url) links, **bold**.

bullets.description: Check list under the copy (plain strings; [label](url) and **bold** allowed).

person_name.description: Attribution or contact name (bold), e.g. Nick Child.

person_role.description: Line under the name, e.g. Manager of Channels and Alliances.

links.description: Arrow links under the copy. Each: label (required), url (required), optional note (a line under the label).

cta_label.description: Primary (gradient) button. Renders only with cta_url.

cta_url.description: Primary button destination (page, #anchor, http(s), mailto: or tel:).

secondary_label.description: Secondary (outline) button. Renders only with secondary_url.

image_width.description: Intrinsic width in px (0 omits it).

image_style.description: photo: rounded 16px corners with a soft shadow; circle: round crop (a headshot); card: inside a white frame (screenshots); plain: as is (illustrations).
